value: Escrow is a contractual arrangement in which a neutral third party holds money or property on behalf of two transacting parties, releasing it only when pre-agreed conditions are met. This mechanism enhances trust and mitigates risk across various dealings, most notably in real estate (for mortgage payments and property closings), but also in secure online transactions, transfers of high-value personal and business assets, intellectual property, and judicial settlements. While providing significant security, users must verify the legitimacy of escrow services, particularly online, due to the prevalence of fraudulent schemes.
